runtimeEscalation.reason: Only authorized external execution can prove runtime claims.

caseAssertions.normal-input: declared sources and contracts are present
caseAssertions.invalid-input: invalid budget, task and lease inputs are rejected
caseAssertions.denied-expansion: network, Unity, Git and resident process expansion is denied
caseAssertions.repeat-idempotency: same schedule produces stable ordering and hashes
caseAssertions.interruption-recovery: cancellation and retry policy are explicitly represented
caseAssertions.deterministic-output: scheduler replay receipt preserves event ordering and non-claims

responsibilityScope: Static authoring replay for bounded WebPageStudio orchestration; runtime worker and browser behavior remain outside this profile.
runtimeBoundary: Static replay proves source and contract structure only; worker, browser, Unity, timing and release behavior remain unverified.
